data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'bonus' meaning 'good', and 'facere' meaning 'to make'. The name Bonifacio is derived from this root and means 'one who makes things good' or 'benefactor'. The name Bonifacio carries the meaning “Good, Beneficent” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Bonifacio usually hope their child will grow to embody good, beneficent and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Bonifacio
in_english.meaning: Goodwill and generosity, blessed and fruitful year, innocence and purity of youth
in_english.long_meaning: Bonifacio is a name that signifies good will and generosity, blessed and fruitful year, and innocence and purity of youth. The name is derived from the Latin word 'bonum facere', meaning 'to do good' or 'to be beneficial'. In Christian tradition, the name Bonifacio is associated with the virtues of benevolence and kindness. The name is also linked to the concept of a 'blessed year' or 'annus liber', symbolizing a period of freedom and liberation. Additionally, the name is associated with the purity and innocence of youth, reflecting the Christian values of moral integrity and spiritual purity.
